version.counsel_reviewer: TO BE RECORDED — every figure below is CapHive's reading of the IFSCA (Fund Management) Regulations, 2025 and is pending counsel review (proposal › Questions for counsel, item 7)
counsel_figures_to_confirm: Minimum investment per investor: Restricted Scheme USD 150,000; Venture Capital Scheme USD 250,000 (accredited investors excluded)
Fund management entity contribution: lower of 2.5% of corpus and USD 750,000 (Venture Capital and Restricted Schemes)
Effective date 01 Jan 2027 is a placeholder

checks.name: Minimum investment per investor (Restricted Scheme)
checks.description: Each investor in a Restricted Scheme must commit at least USD 150,000 (accredited investors excepted). IFSCA sets this floor so only investors able to bear the risk invest. Usually breached when a small commitment is recorded or an accredited investor is not mapped.
checks.citation: IFSCA (Fund Management) Regulations, 2025 — Restricted Scheme minimum investment (counsel to confirm)

checks.name: Minimum investment per investor (Venture Capital Scheme)
checks.description: Each investor in a Venture Capital Scheme must commit at least USD 250,000 (accredited investors excepted). Usually breached when a small commitment is recorded or the accredited-investor list is not mapped.
checks.citation: IFSCA (Fund Management) Regulations, 2025 — Venture Capital Scheme minimum investment (counsel to confirm)

checks.name: Investors in scheme (Restricted Scheme)
checks.description: A Restricted Scheme must have fewer than 1,000 investors, keeping it a private offering under IFSCA rules. Usually breached by a wide close or many small commitments.
checks.citation: IFSCA (Fund Management) Regulations, 2025 — Restricted Scheme investor cap (counsel to confirm)

checks.name: Fund management entity contribution
checks.description: The fund management entity must keep its own money in the scheme: at least the lower of 2.5% of corpus and USD 750,000, so it shares the investors' risk. Usually breached when the corpus grows but the manager's commitment is not topped up.
checks.citation: IFSCA (Fund Management) Regulations, 2025 — FME contribution, lower of 2.5% of corpus and USD 750,000 (counsel to confirm; the USD 750,000 is read in the fund's currency — GIFT schemes are denominated in a foreign currency)

duties.name: Annual compliance report filed with IFSCA
